meta.headline: The onboarding import bug is now an active issue, and the MSA legal review could delay the enterprise launch.
meta.title: Decisions and Risks

risks.title: Onboarding import failures
risks.summary: CSV imports fail silently for files over 5,000 rows; three customers affected this month.
risks.mitigation: Status page shipped Oct 6; root-cause fix targeted for Oct 24.
risks.insight: Touches three renewing accounts worth 18% of Q4 retention.

body.heading: What happens
body.text: Imports over 5,000 rows stop partway with no error, so customers think the data is complete.

body.heading: Affected accounts
body.text:
- Brightline Logistics (renewing in November)
- Harbor Analytics
- Northwind

links.title: Ship an import status page before the root-cause fix

risks.title: Legal review delays enterprise launch
risks.summary: The MSA review is overdue and sits on the launch critical path.
risks.insight: No mitigation recorded. Consider asking outside counsel for a fallback date.

risks.title: Design capacity in Q4
risks.summary: Priya's team is split across three launches.

risks.title: SSO vendor price increase
risks.summary: The identity vendor proposed a 30% increase at renewal.
risks.mitigation: Negotiated a two-year price lock in September.

decisions.title: Enterprise tier priced per seat
decisions.rationale: Buyers budget per seat; per-workspace pricing stalled two deals.

body.heading: Context
body.text: Eight customer interviews in September. Three asked for per-seat pricing outright; none could forecast usage-based costs.

decisions.title: Ship an import status page before the root-cause fix
decisions.summary: Give customers visibility now instead of waiting for the full fix.
decisions.rationale: Support tickets were mostly "is my import done?" questions.

decisions.title: SSO included in enterprise tier
decisions.summary: Proposed: include SSO rather than sell it as an add-on.

decisions.title: Roadmap reviews move to monthly
decisions.summary: Monthly roadmap reviews with a written pre-read.
decisions.rationale: Quarterly reviews surfaced conflicts too late.
